source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-51

procedures.title: Water valve
steps: Replace the valve if it does not work; it cannot be repaired.
notes: See figure 63 in the manual for its installation.

procedures.title: Ambient temperature switch: replace
steps: Unplug the connector at the switch.
Remove the 2 switch-to-case screws and the switch.
Install the new switch in reverse order.
notes: In bi-level mode the compressor runs; this switch stops it in ambients below 30°F. It is in the blower and evaporator case (see figure 64 in the manual).

procedures.title: Diverter door switch: replace
steps: Remove the 2 screws holding the switch to the distributor duct and take out the switch.
Install the new switch in reverse order.
notes: The switch keeps the compressor off in heater mode; on the Corvette that is the right-hand control at HTR.
